_comment: The bundled drivers in this directory are a snapshot, not a source. They
exist because startup is deliberately local: a gateway boots and runs
offline, and a remote refresh must never block it. But they are generated
from srcfl/device-drivers at the commit pinned here, and CI fails if they
drift from it. Editing a .lua file in this directory is not a way to
change a driver -- fix it in device-drivers and move the pin.
The snapshot comes from that repository's source, not from its signed
channel. Channel artifacts are deliberately write-inert, and a gateway
that falls back to this recovery copy still has to be able to control a
Which drivers are bundled is FTW's choice and is the list below.
device-drivers publishes more than these; bundling is for recovery, not
for coverage. Run scripts/sync-bundled-drivers.sh to update.
